title: Chapter 694
text:
Tens of seconds earlier …

Han Xiao was dragged into the deep and mysterious wormhole by EsGod's doppelganger. The moment he entered, countless indescribable and distorted scenes assaulted his senses.

The interior of the wormhole seemed to be blue but was actually black. After entering, the two of them were pulled apart by the space turbulence and could not see each other.

Without needing EsGod's doppelganger to control him, the space turbulence vortex dragged the two of them along, confusing Han Xiao's senses. Sometimes, he felt that he was moving forward, sometimes he felt that he was falling, and sometimes he felt that he was rising. For some reason, it felt like he was flushing a toilet …

The internal screen of the mechanical suit showed that the spacetime coefficient had become undetectable. The thrusters had also failed, and he could not move. His body was firmly sucked in, and the scenery around him changed rapidly. However, upon closer inspection, it became chaos again. At the end of the wormhole, there was a faint light as if that was the exit.

At this time, the square mechanical beacon that Han Xiao had placed in the groove of the mechanical suit started to operate. This was the wormhole probe beacon that Han Xiao had obtained from Harrofal before fighting with EsGod's doppelganger.

Harrofal had a deep understanding of wormholes. As he needed to collect various parameters of the wormhole, the collection team of the observation station had to get close to the wormhole from time to time. Occasionally, someone would be accidentally sucked in. After experimenting, Harrofal had developed a device that could pull people out of wormholes. There were two prerequisites. One was to have the wormhole probe beacon with him, and the other was that the wormhole had been measured before.

Han Xiao knew too well how strong EsGod was. Even his doppelganger was just as strong. As soon as he saw the enemy, he knew that he would most likely not be his opponent in a head-on clash. He had never been arrogant and had always been confident.

Therefore, after hearing about Harrofal's ability, Han Xiao had a flash of inspiration and decided to use himself as bait to lure EsGod's doppelganger into the wormhole before letting Harrofal pull him out. The success rate of this method was clearly much higher than charging forward recklessly.

Although he might not be able to trust Harrofal, he could only take the risk. The worst outcome would be him going to a two-person world with EsGod's doppelganger.

As a Mechanic, Han Xiao knew very well that compared to Mechanics who were good at fighting, those who were good at scientific research were often more effective.

…

As the cause and effect flashed through his mind, Han Xiao heaved a sigh of relief as he understood the enemy's plan.

The Dark-star leader wanted to use the wormhole to banish him, and in turn, using the wormhole as a battlefield could be considered an advantage for him.

He had banished the EsGod doppelganger instead!

"Fortunately, we have Harrofal. Otherwise, we would have been in danger."

Han Xiao glanced at Harrofal beside him and mumbled to himself, "That's right.

At this time, the Dark-star leader who was dumbstruck in the distance came back to his senses. Without saying anything, he turned around and fled. His face was filled with shock and anger, and his expression was twisted.

He had just been immersed in the mission and imagining the future, but in less than a minute, his fantasy was mercilessly shattered by reality. Black Star had actually escaped from the wormhole, but the EsGod doppelganger had not returned. He was completely stunned.

The feeling of falling short of success almost made him lose his mind, but in the next moment, boundless fear drowned out this emotion, causing his soul to tremble.

Without the help of the EsGod doppelganger, Black Star will definitely kill me!

The Dark-star leader did not dare stay any longer and fled in panic. There was only one thought left in his mind … I can't die yet. The hybrid Godora needs me!

However, the Mech Legion on standby fell into Han Xiao's control again and followed him like a nightmare. Millions of mechanical soldiers were like a wave of steel. These emotionless mechanical dead creatures seemed to have become ferocious and evil pure-blooded Godora in the eyes of the Dark-star leader.

The Mech Legion with Mechanical Force bonuses surrounded a Calamity Grade who was not good at group battles. There was no suspense in the battle. Han Xiao only needed to rely on the Mech Legion to take him down easily.

After losing the EsGod doppelganger, the Dark-star leader no longer had any trump cards. In order not to alert the enemy, he only brought a small fleet with him. The rest of the troops that he had obtained from the Fallen Ark were stored in the hands of Klent.

Two Oathkeepers dragged the dying Dark-star leader to Han Xiao. The effects of the Chain of Pain and other spells had long been interrupted, and Han Xiao sized up the Dark-star leader.

"I thought you had already left the Shattered Star Ring. I didn't expect you to dare come back. You escaped a few years ago, but I've finally caught you this time."

Han Xiao tilted his head, and the armor on his left shoulder slid open, revealing a ring device that emitted a blue light. It vibrated slightly and released a circle of air. Like a bubble, the air did not dissipate and enveloped the three of them, allowing them to speak directly.

"…"

The Dark-star leader did not say a word. His face was ashen, and his eyes had lost all light, leaving only defeat and despair.

The Mountain Ape's helmet folded up, and the ring armor on his neck retracted, revealing Han Xiao's face. He sized up the Dark-star leader with interest.

"You can actually summon the EsGod doppelganger. It seems like you've formed a relationship with the Fallen Ark. It should be something that happened during the years you were on the run. Let me think … since you were able to attack me today, it means that you have a very powerful intelligence channel that can lock onto my whereabouts. This time, I was on a secret operation and did not stop at any other planets. This means that the intelligence channel behind you was already monitoring me before I left Colton. Furthermore, they knew that I would come to this wormhole observatory. It seems like they know me very well … "

Han Xiao scratched his head. "Hmm, only the people from Klent like to tail me so much. They're probably the instigators of this operation."

The Dark-star leader still did not say a word. His eyes were blank, as if he was immersed in his own world. It was as if he did not hear Han Xiao at all.

Han Xiao pushed the Dark-star leader's head, but the other party did not react. He did not even look at Han Xiao. It was as if his eyes had no focus, and his eyes did not move at all.

"Why aren't you saying anything? Do you think I won't mess with you just because you're like an ostrich?"

Harrofal heard this from the side and could not help but cough. He softly said, "Do I need to avoid suspicion?"

"No, you can be my witness."

After casually replying, Han Xiao turned around to look at the Dark-star leader and frowned.

Strange, I only beat him up and did not do anything else. Why does it seem like I've played with him until he's broken?

Han Xiao did not know that the Dark-star leader had fallen into the hands of Black Star. He felt that everything was over, so he did not want to say anything and was at the mercy of Black Star.

"No way, you're breaking down just like that?" Han Xiao stared at the Dark-star leader's eyes, curled his lips, and said, "You're too weak mentally. You're the leader of a galactic terrorist organization? Even the native leader of a rebel organization in my hometown has more backbone than you. You're so weak. "

Han Xiao thought for a while, summoned two Phantoms, and transformed them into layers of seals, locking the Dark-star leader in place. He then took out the juicer and extracted a dozen tubes of Gene Serums.

When he saw the Super-Gene Extractor, the Dark-star leader's eyes finally moved. "The Secret Message Bead is indeed in your hands."

"Yeah." Han Xiao remembered that the first time he interacted with the Dark-star was because of the mission of the Secret Message Bead. "By the way, where did Ashes go?"

"… He's dead." The Dark-star leader lowered his head.

"Oh, that's good." Han Xiao raised his brows. It seemed like the result of the Destiny's Child Character Summon Card was correct.

He was not interested in how Ashes died at all. In fact, when he saw EsGod's doppelganger, he already knew what was going on.

Capturing the Dark-star leader was a pleasant surprise of this trip, and Han Xiao felt that he had gained a lot. Klent was most likely the backer of Dark-star, and they actually had something to do with EsGod. This made him feel that he had to be more careful.

The role of the Dark-star leader was not only to juicer but also to hand this war criminal over to Godora. This should be able to trigger Legendary Points and dungeon creation rights, representing the complete destruction of the Dark-star organization.

Godora would definitely publicize this, and it might even help with the [Bloodline] mission.

However, Han Xiao was not satisfied with just the benefits of a Star System civilization. With his current level, a Star Cluster civilization was a more suitable partner. Since he had discovered the connection between Dark-star and Klent, he felt that he could make an issue out of it, and Purple Crystal would definitely be willing to publicize this.

The use was also very obvious. Klent's previous experience of funding terrorist organizations and disrupting Star Systems was enough to make the West Wind, Kaya, and Chaida Star Systems increase their vigilance against Klent. This could indirectly restore Purple Crystal's control over these three border Star Systems and reduce the effect of Bloodshed Land's work.

Furthermore, the Lord of the Fallen Ark was notorious in the entire universe and was a thug that the three Universal Civilizations hated the most. Once the relationship between Klent and EsGod was exposed, political pressure would come one after another. The Red Empire might even be dissatisfied with Klent, their new underling.

Not to mention the external pressure from Klent, there was also the possibility of a harem fire. Their ally, Heber, might not necessarily want to share a husband with EsGod.

Of course, it was also possible that he had guessed wrong, and Klent was actually not the mastermind behind Dark-star …

However, it did not matter.

The Dark-star leader was in his hands. If he said he was the mastermind, he would be the mastermind!

Han Xiao was determined to give Klent benefits. Another pot!

Putting away all the potions, Han Xiao flipped his palm, and a compressed orb popped out from the mechanical suit's tube. With a little stimulation from his Mechanical Force, this compressed orb expanded layer by layer and quickly turned into a single-person aircraft about ten meters long.

The small standard spaceship that they were originally on had been destroyed. Although they could leave with the Mountain Ape mode, it was not convenient for them to bring captives. Thus, they could only take out a single-person aircraft and leave the wormhole area first.

"Professor Harrofal, I'll send you to the nearest planet first."

"Sure."

Han Xiao put away the Mech Legion and brought the two of them onto the spaceship. He asked Harrofal to help guard the Dark-star leader while he sat in the pilot's seat.

At this time, Han Xiao seemed to have thought of something and asked, "Oh, right.

Where does the wormhole that I fell into lead to? EsGod's doppelganger did not escape, so where will he be teleported to? "

Harrofal shook his head. "The other end of that wormhole is not fixed. We've measured the data, and the other end of this wormhole is changing all the time. I don't know where that guy will fall to either. However, according to probability, it's more likely that he will fall to the unexplored universe. After all, that wormhole is very big, and the energy fluctuations are very intense."

"Is that so …" Han Xiao scratched the back of his head.

EsGod's doppelganger had energy limitations and would dissipate after a while. As long as he did not fall into a busy area, he would be very safe.

Dark blue flames shot out from the tail of the aircraft, and it slowly accelerated, gradually turning into a stream of light and disappearing from this wormhole area.

…

Somewhere in the unexplored universe.

A wormhole was spinning quietly. Suddenly, a human figure flew out from the wormhole. It was EsGod's doppelganger.

After stabilizing himself, EsGod's doppelganger stood at the entrance of the wormhole and waited for a long time, but he did not see his friend, Black Star, coming to meet him.

The red light spots on EsGod's doppelganger's face shone brightly, vaguely emitting the resentment of being stood up.

The doppelganger and the main body had a mental connection. The main body could see the doppelganger's actions, control the doppelganger, and also be a bystander. EsGod had always liked to be a bystander and let his doppelganger do what he wanted. To him, it was like watching a first-person movie.

Because he had this ability, he liked to play with wormholes and leave the fate of his doppelganger to fate.

EsGod's main body was still a bystander when he attacked Black Star this time, watching his doppelganger do what he wanted. He actually did not care about Klent's request. Seeing that Black Star did not seem to be affected, EsGod was a little curious. He remembered this person and then threw the mission to the back of his mind to see where his doppelganger was thrown to this time.

EsGod's doppelganger looked left and right, randomly choosing a direction, and started to teleport continuously over long distances.

The consumption of teleportation was very small, but it lasted for a very long time. A lot of energy was consumed in the doppelganger's body, and the red light spots dimmed. At this time, EsGod's doppelganger finally saw a planet.

It was a strange planet.

Looking from afar, the surface of the planet was green and full of life, as if there were no traces of artificial modification. However, EsGod's doppelganger's detection Esper Ability also sensed countless highly intelligent life forms living on the surface.

The most special thing was that thick vines grew on the surface of this planet, extending all the way to the atmosphere and into outer space. The ends of these vines were connected to stable wormholes.

EsGod's doppelganger took a closer look and suddenly realized that he seemed to have seen it the wrong way.

It was not that there were vines growing on the planet but that these vines were extending from the wormholes in outer space of the planet, connecting to the surface of the planet. This meant that these vines did not grow from the ground but from the wormholes. The surface of the planet was the end of these vines.

All kinds of lights were born from the ends of the vines on the surface of the planet and flowed into the wormholes through the vines. It was as if these vines were nutrient pipes, absorbing the energy of this planet.

Seeing this scene through his doppelganger, EsGod's main body, who was sitting on the throne in the palace of the Fallen Ark, opened his eyes.
